overview: The developer’s September 2026 launch release describes a Sharjah master community combining homes with retail, hospitality, education and leisure. Its six-cluster concept centres on a planned 1.7-million-square-foot Central Park.
research.locationNote: Um Fanain, Sharjah, as identified by Property Finder. Brochure maps describe regional road connections; no precise coordinate, guaranteed commute or cross-emirate travel time is asserted.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays an AED 1.9m launch guide. The developer’s published launch release separately quotes US-dollar townhouse entry pricing. No current dated selected-unit offer was retrieved, so no currency conversion, availability claim or price attribution to the illustrated layouts is made.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder summarises 10% at launch, 20% during construction and 70% at handover. This is a secondary project guide, not a verified dated schedule for every cluster or home. Obtain the actual selected-unit offer and due dates.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts Q3/July 2029, including 1 July in its timeline. A large multi-cluster community should not acquire one contractual date from that summary. Confirm the selected release and current developer agreement; no handover readiness is implied.

facts.label: Launch masterplan · planned scope
facts.value: The developer’s release describes 1,130 villas, more than 6,000 townhouses and 3,500 apartments around a 1.7m ft² Central Park. These are planned programme figures, not current available or delivered stock.

facts.label: Brochure landscape share
facts.value: 25% parks and green space in the brochure, not a confirmed as-built survey.

unresolved: These are selected marketing-plan summaries; sellable area and plot area are different measurements. No net interior or live inventory range is inferred. Apartment plans and later release revisions require their own documents. The headline type groups this selection under townhouses; the separately described villas and planned apartments retain their own layouts.

Current selected-unit availability, exact price, dated instalments, contractual completion, final finishes, parking, service charges, ownership conditions and approved facility operations remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
Retail, hospitality, education and leisure elements are planned. Their inclusion in a masterplan does not establish delivery, licensing, opening dates or access rights for every home.
